original_question: Kim afi ankasa fie adwuma ho nneɛma ase, na bu akonta ne ho ahwɛ mfasoɔ a ɔbenya afi n'adwumamfoɔ no hɔ. Na ɔwɔ adwumamfoɔ 3 deda, nanso ɔne wɔn a ɔbetumi ayɛ n'adwumamfoɔ amono 5 bɔ nkɔmmɔ, na ɔte nka sɛ ɔwɔ ahotoso sɛ ɔde wɔn bɛka n'adwenkyerɛ no ho. ɔdetɔfoɔ biara fie behia bleach ntoa 2 ne mpopaho nkotoku biako a wɔbɛhoro. Ntoa bleach bo yɛ $2 baako, na atade bo bɛyɛ $5 baako. Eyinom yɛ nea ɔbɔ ho ka nkoa. Ɔbu akontaa sɛ ne sika a obenya nnawɔtwe biara bɛyɛ $92. Mfasoɔ no yɛ nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda sika a wonya ne sika a wɔbɔ so nyinaa ntam, enti mfaso no dodow ahe na Lucas benya, wɔ dɔla mu, nnawɔtwe biara?
